div.div: 4 اعكمهُ He assisted him to perform what is termed العَكْم [i. e. the binding, or tying up, of his goods, or the binding them upon a camel]; (S, K;) [and so ↓ عَكَمَهُ ; for] a man says to his companion, اِعْكِمْنِى and أَعْكِمْنِى, meaning Assist thou me to perform العَكْم; like as one says اُحْلُبْنِى [and أَحْلِبْنِى], meaning “ Assist thou me to milk. ” (Fr, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
